name: sujin
description: React + Node + WordPress theme for sujinc.com

scripts.install-modules: yarn --cwd ./@auth && yarn --cwd ./@common && yarn --cwd ./@graphql && yarn --cwd ./@lib && yarn --cwd ./@next && yarn --cwd ./@wordpress install-modules
scripts.build: yarn --cwd ./@auth build && yarn --cwd ./@common build && yarn --cwd ./@lib build && yarn --cwd ./@wordpress build
scripts.lint: yarn lint:auth && yarn lint:common && yarn lint:gql && yarn lint:lib && yarn lint:next && yarn lint:wordpress
